metrics.name: Heart rate
metrics.meaning: Heartbeats per minute.

metrics.name: HRV · RMSSD
metrics.meaning: Variation between successive beat intervals, using RMSSD. Compare the same method and measurement period.

metrics.name: HRV · SDNN
metrics.meaning: Standard deviation of normal beat intervals. This is a different quantity from RMSSD.

metrics.name: Skin conductance
metrics.meaning: Electrical conductance at the skin. This does not identify an emotion or its cause.

metrics.name: Skin temperature
metrics.meaning: Absolute temperature at the skin sensor, not core body temperature.

metrics.name: Skin temperature change
metrics.meaning: Change from the source baseline. This is not an absolute skin temperature.

metrics.name: Movement
metrics.meaning: Standard deviation of acceleration magnitude over the reported interval. This is not a step count.

metrics.name: Respiratory rate
metrics.meaning: Breaths per minute over the reported measurement interval.

metrics.name: Oxygen saturation
metrics.meaning: Oxygen saturation reported by the sensor, with its measurement method preserved.

metrics.name: Steps
metrics.meaning: Steps counted during the reported interval. Counts from overlapping sources are not added together.

metrics.name: Beat interval · RR
metrics.meaning: Individual beat interval reported by the heart-rate sensor. This is not an HRV score.

metrics.name: Pulse interval · PPI
metrics.meaning: Raw interval between optical pulse peaks; check the accompanying PPI sensor flags. Zero denotes unavailable. This is not an HRV score.

metrics.name: PPI error estimate
metrics.meaning: Error estimate supplied by the optical sensor for its pulse interval.

metrics.name: PPI sensor flags
metrics.meaning: Polar PPI flags: bit 0 invalid interval; bit 1 contact detected; bit 2 contact detection unsupported.

metrics.name: ECG
metrics.meaning: Raw electrical cardiac waveform. No rhythm classification is performed.

metrics.name: Blood volume pulse
metrics.meaning: Optical pulse waveform in source-specific arbitrary units. Values from different sensors are not interchangeable.

metrics.name: Core body temperature
metrics.meaning: Temperature explicitly identified by the source as core body temperature.

metrics.name: Body temperature
metrics.meaning: Temperature reported by a health thermometer. It is not automatically classified as skin or core temperature.

metrics.name: Sensor temperature
metrics.meaning: Temperature stream with unspecified measurement location. Do not equate this with skin temperature.

metrics.name: Barometric pressure
metrics.meaning: Atmospheric pressure reported by the sensor. This is not blood pressure.

metrics.name: Acceleration · X
metrics.meaning: Raw acceleration along the sensor axis, including gravity.

metrics.name: Angular velocity · X
metrics.meaning: Raw gyroscope measurement along the sensor axis.

metrics.name: Magnetic field · X
metrics.meaning: Raw magnetic field along the sensor axis.

metrics.name: Acceleration · Y
metrics.meaning: Raw acceleration along the sensor axis, including gravity.

metrics.name: Angular velocity · Y
metrics.meaning: Raw gyroscope measurement along the sensor axis.

metrics.name: Magnetic field · Y
metrics.meaning: Raw magnetic field along the sensor axis.

metrics.name: Acceleration · Z
metrics.meaning: Raw acceleration along the sensor axis, including gravity.

metrics.name: Angular velocity · Z
metrics.meaning: Raw gyroscope measurement along the sensor axis.

metrics.name: Magnetic field · Z
metrics.meaning: Raw magnetic field along the sensor axis.

metrics.name: Pulse interval quality
metrics.meaning: Samsung optical interval status: 0 normal, -1 error. This is separate from Polar PPI flags.

metrics.name: Heart rate quality
metrics.meaning: Samsung heart rate status: 1 successful; 0 measuring; negative values identify movement, contact or sensor errors.

metrics.name: EDA quality
metrics.meaning: Samsung EDA status: 0 normal, -5 detached, -10 low signal quality.

metrics.name: Temperature quality
metrics.meaning: Samsung temperature status: 0 normal, -1 error.

metrics.name: ECG electrode contact
metrics.meaning: Samsung ECG lead-off code: 0 indicates electrode contact; other values indicate no contact.

metrics.name: Oxygen measurement status
metrics.meaning: Samsung SpO2 status: 2 complete, 0 calculating, negative values identify timeout, movement or low quality.

metrics.name: Green PPG quality
metrics.meaning: Samsung optical channel status: 0 normal, -1 unavailable or blocked.

metrics.name: Infrared PPG quality
metrics.meaning: Samsung optical channel status: 0 normal, -1 unavailable or blocked.

metrics.name: Red PPG quality
metrics.meaning: Samsung optical channel status: 0 normal, -1 unavailable or blocked.

metrics.name: Heart sensor contact
metrics.meaning: Bluetooth heart sensor contact: 1 detected, 0 not detected. Only reported when the device supports contact detection.

metrics.name: Thermometer site
metrics.meaning: Bluetooth thermometer location code: 1 armpit, 2 body, 3 ear, 4 finger, 5 gastrointestinal, 6 mouth, 7 rectum, 8 toe, 9 eardrum.

metrics.name: Magnetometer calibration
metrics.meaning: Polar calibration quality code: 0 unknown, 1 poor, 2 OK, 3 good.

metrics.name: Oximeter measurement flags
metrics.meaning: Raw device status bits. Consult the source protocol; this is not a physiological score.

metrics.name: Oximeter sensor flags
metrics.meaning: Raw device status bits. Consult the source protocol; this is not a physiological score.

metrics.name: ECG raw status
metrics.meaning: Raw device status bits. Consult the source protocol; this is not a physiological score.

metrics.name: PPG raw status
metrics.meaning: Raw device status bits. Consult the source protocol; this is not a physiological score.

metrics.name: ECG packet sequence
metrics.meaning: Samsung ECG sequence counter, wrapping at 255. It is not a beat count.

metrics.name: ECG ADC · 1
metrics.meaning: Unscaled electrical sensor channel from Polar frame 3. It must not be treated as microvolts without a documented conversion.

metrics.name: ECG ADC · 2
metrics.meaning: Unscaled electrical sensor channel from Polar frame 3. It must not be treated as microvolts without a documented conversion.

metrics.name: Sensor energy counter
metrics.meaning: Cumulative energy reported by the heart-rate sensor. It may reset; do not sum successive readings.

metrics.name: Pulse amplitude index
metrics.meaning: Perfusion-related amplitude index reported by the oximeter. It is not oxygen saturation.

metrics.name: Oxygen saturation · fast
metrics.meaning: Device fast estimate from the pulse oximeter. Smoothing differs from the normal estimate.

metrics.name: Pulse rate · fast
metrics.meaning: Device fast pulse estimate. Kept separate from normal pulse because its smoothing differs.

metrics.name: Oxygen saturation · slow
metrics.meaning: Device slow estimate from the pulse oximeter. Smoothing differs from the normal estimate.

metrics.name: Pulse rate · slow
metrics.meaning: Device slow pulse estimate. Kept separate from normal pulse because its smoothing differs.
